description.p: Voz lives in the system tray and records your microphone and/or the system audio you hear — so it captures meetings locally without ever joining them — transcribes on-device with Whisper, and turns each recording into two linked Obsidian-friendly notes: a verbatim Raw transcript and a Refined note. The refine step runs through an LLM you choose (Claude Code / Codex CLI, a local model, or the Claude API). Everything stays on your machine.
